thought.text:
**Kabar bagus!** Obscurify menerima tool result sebagai **list** — beda dari nomask. Berarti **bisa dipakai di OpenHands**.

Saya cek satu hal lagi: apakah ada masalah prefix.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 250 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
print("=== apakah obscurify terima prefix openai/ ? ===")
for m in ["deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking",
          "openai/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking"]:
    p={"model":m,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":300}
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=json.dumps(p).encode(),
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=120) as x: d=json.load(x)
        print(f"  {m[:60]:60} -> 200 content={repr((d['choices'][0]['message'].get('content') or '')[:30])}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(f"  {m[:60]:60} -> HTTP{e.code} {e.read().decode()[:80]}")
print()
print("=== saldo ===")
r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/get_user_balance",headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30) as x: print(" ",x.read().decode())
PY
